# braintrust_acl (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust ACL (access control list) entry. ACLs grant a permission or role to a user or group on a specific object.

ACLs are **immutable** — any attribute change requires destroying and recreating the ACL. ACLs are inherited through the object hierarchy (e.g., a project ACL applies to all experiments and datasets within it).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) The ID of the object the ACL applies to.
- `object_type` (String) The type of object the ACL applies to.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group the ACL applies to. Exactly one of user_id and group_id must be provided.
- `permission` (String) The permission the ACL grants. Exactly one of permission and role_id must be provided.
- `restrict_object_type` (String) Optionally restricts the permission to a specific object type. Cannot be set when role_id is used.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the role the ACL grants. Exactly one of permission and role_id must be provided.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user the ACL applies to. Exactly one of user_id and group_id must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of ACL creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the ACL (UUID).
- `object_org_id` (String) The organization the ACL's referenced object belongs to.
